sections.bio:
I’m Manish Bhati, an AI Visual Artist, Creative Storyteller, and Founder of Mahi Visuals — a creative studio where imagination meets artificial intelligence.

Experience in AI filmmaking, fashion visuals, cinematic storytelling, and surreal art, I specialize in transforming ideas into emotionally powerful visuals.

Through Mahi Visuals, I collaborate with global AI tools like Pika Labs, Pixverse, and Ideogram and flora as a Creator Partner and Beta Tester, crafting next-gen content that bridges art, technology, and emotion.

My vision is to push the boundaries of AI creativity — building experiences that inspire, educate, and redefine how visuals are perceived in the digital era.

🎨 Focus Areas: AI Filmmaking • Visual Design • Creative Direction • Storytelling • Beta Testing opportunity and availability for Creative Partnership.

posts.text:
